objective: Produce independently replayable PEAD signal inputs from an exhaustive event census, licensed point-in-time consensus, independent SEC announcement actuals, conservative known-public-by activation, and separately verified Sharadar market evidence.

permitted_roles: SF1 ARQ event-census lineage without using SF1 values as signal actuals
dated CIK, permaticker, ticker, listing, and delisting identity
SEP split-normalized denominator and contemporaneous closeunadj evidence
dated market capitalization and size inputs
corporate-action and terminal-return evidence only after separate semantic qualification
provider as-of dates and trusted availability fields

independent_announcement_lane.source_family: SEC 8-K Item 2.02 filing metadata and issuer exhibit bytes plus independent availability evidence
permitted_roles: reported actual and exact metric semantics from preserved SEC issuer-exhibit bytes
conservative known-public-by upper bound from a closed availability adapter

sharadar_acquisition_and_identity.authoritative_boundary: Reopen immutable SF1, SEP, and TICKERS acquisition receipts and exact source bytes, replay CSV-to-Parquet row equivalence, and rederive dated identity from bound TICKERS bytes.

sharadar_official_semantics.authoritative_boundary: Reopen the exact licensed SHARADAR/INDICATORS response and require the closed official definitions for SEP ticker, date, close, and closeunadj.

event_census_and_child_universe.authoritative_boundary: Account for every source-census row exactly once as expected_event, identity_gap, or out_of_scope. Frozen v1 retains its original global identity-gap blocker; v2 retains each affected-row exclusion while requiring a complete nonempty census and unrelated expected events.

sharadar_event_universe_replay.authoritative_boundary: Reopen SF1 and TICKERS evidence, use ARQ as the frozen quarterly scope, retain every source revision and provider fiscal-period label, refuse share-class guesses, rebuild ten children and their root index, and require externally supplied specification and construction-code roots.

annual_event_universe_index.authoritative_boundary: Bind all nonempty calendar-year children, require contiguous target coverage, common roots, and globally unique event IDs.

consensus_normalization_replay.authoritative_boundary: Reopen exact licensed raw bytes and rebuild the raw-row ledger and normalized consensus evidence under five independently supplied hash allowlists.

announcement_actual_evidence.authoritative_boundary: Replay preserved SEC 8-K Item 2.02 metadata and issuer-exhibit bytes into a canonical actual while retaining EDGAR acceptance separately from availability.

announcement_availability.authoritative_boundary: Replay evidence-class-specific availability evidence and derive only a conservative known-public-by upper bound under external trust roots.

event_source_reconciliation.authoritative_boundary: For one child universe, invoke consensus raw replay, validate externally trusted SEC actual and availability evidence, enforce exact metric semantics and conservative prior-date selection, and rebuild one disposition per event.

market_accounting_receipt.authoritative_boundary: Replay Sharadar source, identity, event lineage, source reconciliation, SEP semantic profile, and official NYSE source evidence; select the unique latest positive SEP row strictly before activation with no fallback.

final_signal_input_reconciliation.authoritative_boundary: Replay one child source and market receipt, prove common identity/share basis, compute the frozen signal with exact rational and Decimal-34 math, and accept or exclude every child event.

cross_partition_signal_input_index.authoritative_boundary: Replay and bind exactly ten annual final receipts to the authoritative event replay/index, enforce ordered exhaustive coverage and global uniqueness, and aggregate only derived counts and blocker identities.

child_rules: ARQ is the sole quarterly source scope; provider fiscalperiod is diagnostic
each annual source intersection is represented exactly once
each child is nonempty and qualification_allowed
every source-census row receives exactly one disposition
identity gaps exclude only affected rows and never authorize share-class guessing
expected events are determined before consensus or announcement availability is inspected
event IDs are unique within and across children
annual_event_partition_plan.downstream_rule: Produce source, market, and final signal receipts per child and authoritatively bind all ten final receipts in pead_signal_input_index.v1.

trust_boundaries.binding_rule: Every allowlist is canonically sorted, hashed as pead_sha256_trust_root_set.v1, and bound into the consuming receipt.
trust_boundaries.trust_registry_owner: independent reviewer or controlled external registry, not the artifact producer

immutability.structured_artifacts: SHA-256 over schema-declared canonical JSON payload
immutability.rule_change_policy: Any source, universe, activation, signal, portfolio, statistical-family, or qualification-boundary change requires a new versioned package.
